extension.summary: Recently played movies and episodes from any add-on
آخر الأفلام والحلقات التي شاهدتها من أي إضافة
extension.description: Records what you play - Kodi library, TMDbHelper, Fen Light, Seren, Umbrella or any other video add-on - and lists it newest first with artwork, progress and a working replay link. Widget-ready lists: all, movies, episodes, in progress. Built for Kodi 21/22.
يسجل ما تشاهده من مكتبة كودي أو أي إضافة فيديو ويعرضه من الأحدث مع الصور ونسبة المشاهدة ورابط تشغيل يعمل. قوائم جاهزة للودجات: الكل، الأفلام، الحلقات، قيد المشاهدة.
extension.news: v1.0.8 - New add-on artwork matching NewPipe: clearlogo, banner and fanart with the emblem on the right. v1.0.7 - Crash fix: focused-item tracking no longer reads list labels inside dialogs, the Add-on Browser, File Browser or while a list is rebuilding, and pauses for 10s after playback ends (return-to-Home skin rebuild). One gated check per second, labels re-read only when focus changes. v1.0.6 - Records Fen Light / debrid streams that start without metadata: waits for the info tag, then falls back to script.trakt.ids, the TMDbHelper launcher and the focused item. v1.0.5 - Replay choice: play the saved stream link (instant, like the old Last Played) or play again from sources; setting for Ask / Saved first / Sources only, expired links fall back to sources. v1.0.2 - New ABUKARIM-style icons and fanart on a solid dark background; new "Buy Me a Coffee" entry opens a QR code. v1.0.1 - heartbeat so ABUKARIM TOOLS can start the service when Kodi skips it at boot. v1.0.0 - first release (replaces plugin.video.last_played)
